best_idea: When a 2D map view pans by a few pixels, move the pixels that are still on screen with one blit and redraw only the exposed strips, and never copy or redraw a part that a window in front covers.
decision_why: Keep the carve-and-strip method for the 2D minimap and world map pan only; the 3D fight view moves every frame and keeps nothing, so it does not use it. Client-only, engine untouched.
acceptance: A unit test on the planner (no GPU) asserts a 40 px pan with one overlay window in front blits only the uncovered pieces and the redrawn strips cover exactly the newly exposed area, with no strip under the overlay; in play a minimap pan on a phone redraws only a strip the width of the pan.
